Mustafa Muhammed vs Muvattupuzha Municipality on 13 
December, 2024
Wp(C) No.44563/2024 1/4 Order Date : 13-12-2
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr.Justice Ziyad Rahman A.A.
 Friday, the 13th day of December 2024 / 22nd Agrahayana, 1946
 Wp(C) No. 44563 Of 2024
 Petitioner: 
 Mustafa Muhammed, Aged 63 Years S/O. Muhammed Hanif, Residing At
 Thaze Nanoth House, Koorara P O, Mokeri, Kannur, Pin - 670694
 Respondent:
 1. Muvattupuzha Municipality, Municipal Office, Muvattupuzha Old Bridge
 Road,Thottummalpeedika, Muvattupuzha, Ernakulam District Rep. By Its
 Secretary, Pin - 686673
 2. The Secretary, Muvattupuzha Municipality,Municipal Office,
 Muvattupuzha Old Bridge Road,Thottummalpeedika, Muvattupuzha,
 Ernakulam District, Pin - 686673
 3. The District Transport Officer, Kerala State Road Transport
 Corporation,Muvattupuzha P O, Ernakulam District, Pin - 686673
 Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances
 stated in the affidavit filed along with the Wp(C) the High Court be
 pleased to direct the 1st respondent to permit the petitioner to continue
 the tea shop established in the kerala state road transport corporation
 bus station, muvattuppuzha based on ext p1 agreement and ext p2 extension
 order, pending disposal of the above writ petition. 
 This petition coming on for orders upon perusing the petition and  the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and upon hearing the arguments of  M/S. ATHIRA A.MENON & T.THASMI Advocates for the petitioner and  of SRI.RAJAN T R Advocate for the respondents 1 & 2, the court passed the  following:
 WP(C) No.44563/2024 2/4 Order Date : 1  ZIYAD RAHMAN A.A., J.
 ========================
 W.P(C) No.44563 of 2024  ========================
 Dated this the 13th day of December, 2024  ORDER Mustafa Muhammed vs Muvattupuzha Municipality on 13 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120129433/ 
1 Admit.
2. Sri .T.R. Rajan, the learned Standing Counsel takes notice for the respondents 1 and 2. Sri.Akhil Suresh, the learned Standing Counsel takes notice for the 3rd respondent. 
3. Considering the fact that, the petitioner herein is conducting a tea shop on the basis of Ext.P1 agreement executed between the petitioner and the KSRTC and also that, the petitioner has obtained Ext.P4 from the Department of Industries and Commerce, under Kerala Micro Small Medium Enterprises Facilitation Rules, 2020 to set up a service enterprise, I am inclined to pass an interim order. Moreover, the petitioner has also obtained Ext.P5 license from the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India as well. Besides, it is an undisputed fact that the petitioner has been conducting the shop since 2022. In such circumstances, there shall be an interim order staying further proceedings pursuant to WP(C) No.44563/2024 3/4 Order Date : 13-12-2024 Ext.P6 for a period of two months. 
A statement/counter affidavit shall be placed on record by the respondents within three weeks. Post on 24.01.2025. 
Sd/-
